scope: Static independent review of current conditional model/sampling and feature chronology against the request draft; not a profitability claim or independent runner review.
checks: Unique stock/date draws precede target availability inspection and rejected labels have no replacement.
Every six-head label end is strictly before outer fitting/calibration and inner training/validation boundaries.
Imputation/scaling fit only each training subset; calibration cannot select family or refit preprocessing.
Common causal reference notionals and equal-date/equal-horizon utility loss match the draft, with zero-quantity rows retained.
All three inner folds required, exact tie selects Ridge, final selected-family failure abstains without fallback.
Calibration uses later-only per-row mean error; downside clipped before and after correction as declared.
Predictor takes features only and does not require test labels; saved raw/corrected outputs and exact reload checks retained.
Feature context uses same-date completed inputs, preceding252 RV median and declared duplicate aliases.

coordination.topic: training-only setup means and calibration-defined test reliability
coordination.finding: The model module only provides a pooled-union training mean for inner diagnostics.
coordination.resolution: Model owner confirms strategy_design isolated runner owns setup-specific priors and later test reliability; runner owner notified.
coordination.remaining: Verify final runner integration separately before study launch.

limitations: Review covers exact recorded file hashes; integrated final suite remains the root task responsibility while other agents finish.
Does not resolve frozen-vintage source actions, survivorship or empirical forecast usefulness.
